title: Benno's Bacon Potato Salad
description: Benno's bacon potato salad recipe is a zesty, spicy potato salad made with red potatoes, bacon, celery, mild banana peppers, and banana pepper brine.
ingredients: 1 pound red potatoes, scrubbed and cut into quarters
2 slices thick-cut bacon, cut into 1-inch squares
0.25 cup mild yellow pepper rings, drained
2 tablespoons juice from yellow pepper rings
Creole seasoning (such as Tony Chachere's®), or to taste

steps.text: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with lightly salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and cool. Slice potatoes; transfer to a large bowl. Set aside.
Add celery, onion, bacon, and pepper rings to a large skillet; cook and stir until bacon is brown and celery begins to soften, about 10 minutes.
Combine mayonnaise, pepper brine, mustard, horseradish, lemon juice, and Creole seasoning in a bowl until dressing is well blended.
Stir celery mixture and dressing into potatoes to coat. Refrigerate before serving for 30 minutes.
